id.description:
Identifier used by `last_group` and by `group` item references:
`^[a-z0-9_]{1,32}$`.

name.description:
What the group bar shows. Not translated: what the author typed is what
is displayed (§14).

source.description:
A dynamic group's source (`folder:<path>`, `recent`, `most_used`), §17.2 G.

A group with one has no items of its own: its items are generated at
runtime and never written back, so a file that also lists items drops them
with a warning.

cwd.description: Working directory; the executable's own folder when absent.

extra.description: Free-form data for `command` / `plugin:*`; must be empty otherwise.

icon.description: Custom icon: a `.ico` or `.png` path in this milestone (§9).

items.description: Item ids a `group` item launches, in order.

name.description: What the tile shows. Not translated.

tags.description: Extra words the M2 filter also matches on.

type.description:
`app` | `folder` | `file` | `url` | `uwp` | `command` | `group` |
`plugin:<id>`. Unknown kinds are kept so that a file written by a newer
build still round-trips.

OnRunning.description: What launching an application that is already running should do.

oneOf.description: Bring the existing window to the front.

View.description: How the window lays its items out.

oneOf.description: A list of rows, one item per row.

auto_hide.description: Hide the window when it loses focus.

cell_size.description: Grid cell edge in logical pixels, clamped to `64..=160`.

close_after_launch.description: Hide the window once an item has been launched.

columns.description:
Grid columns, clamped to `2..=16`. Kept for files written before the grid
sized itself: its columns now come from `cell_size` and the window.

hotkey.description:
The global summon chord, in `global-hotkey` syntax. Empty = not
registered, so the window can only be summoned from inside LumaFiles.

icon_size.description:
Icon edge in logical pixels; any other value snaps to the nearest of
[`ICON_SIZES`].

keep_running.description:
Keep the process alive after the main window is closed, so the summon
chord still works (§15.0).

list_columns.description:
Columns of the list view, clamped to `1..=3`. Kept for files written
before the list sized itself: its columns now come from the window's width.

on_running.description: What to do when an application is already running.

show_cells.description:
Draw the cells' blocks, the empty ones included. Off leaves the icons and
names on the window's own background (§12.1).

topmost.description: Keep the window above ordinary windows.

group.description: The groups, in the order the group bar shows them.

schema_version.description: Schema the file was written with.
